english_text: Madam President , less than a fortnight ago you spoke about a previous killing in the Basque country . In the meantime , 57 people have been arrested . The conflict in the Basque country bears some resemblance to that in Northern Ireland . They hold the view that the only possible position on armed struggle and the underlying nationalism is to wipe them out . Until the paths taken in London and Dublin become the main model for Madrid and Paris it seems that the political landscape will remain as it is . You , Madam President , will continue to back the Spanish strategy , and I will continue to say what my Spanish colleagues dislike most . That is a very sad reality .
